system.description:
Bucklers and target shields are Power 1, VA –, WS 2, shortest weapons when used as a weapon in combat (Armor and Shields, p. 483). The Weapons Appendix lists a generic Shield as Power 1, Add 2, WS 1, short.

Run of the Mill Arms cost 5 rps for the character's whole idiom of hand weapons (e.g. sword, lance and dagger for a knight).

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 483
